`apps/gateway` is a Cloudflare Worker routed on `tuturuuu.com/*`. It serves
anonymous public pages from the Workers Cache API and proxies everything else to
the Vercel production web deployment unchanged. It exists to cut Vercel
serverless and bandwidth cost for traffic that does not need a render.

The Worker is not deployed from source control. The provider owner deploys it
and attaches the route; more specific routes (for example the roadmap Worker on
`tuturuuu.com/roadmap*`) keep winning over `tuturuuu.com/*`.

## Behavior

- **Manifest:** `apps/gateway/src/manifest.json` maps URL patterns to an origin
  and a cache class. `page` is an anonymous public page, `static` is a build or
  public asset, and anything unmatched is `bypass` (pure pass-through). A unit
  test checks that every path in
  `apps/web/src/lib/seo/public-routes.generated.json` is a `page` route, so the
  manifest cannot drift from the marketing pages.
- **Cache:** `GET` and `HEAD` on `page` and `static` routes. Fresh for 5 minutes,
  then served stale for up to 1 hour while a background refresh runs
  (`X-Gateway-Cache: HIT | STALE | MISS`). Only `200` responses without
  `Set-Cookie` and without `Vary: *` are stored. Pages vary by locale bucket
  (path prefix, then `NEXT_LOCALE`, then `Accept-Language`); `GET` and `HEAD`
  share an entry; tracking query parameters (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`,
  `msclkid`) are not part of the key.
- **Bypass:** non-`GET`/`HEAD` methods, `Authorization`, `Range`, RSC requests
  (`RSC`, `Next-Router-*`, `Next-Action` headers or `_rsc` parameter) and, for
  pages, any session-like cookie (`sb-*`, names containing `session`, `auth` or
  `token`, `tuturuuu*`, `__Secure-`/`__Host-`). Static assets ignore cookies.
  Bypassed requests are forwarded with method, headers, body and cookies
  untouched; redirects are not followed and `Set-Cookie` is returned as sent.
- **Redirects:** a `Location` that points at the origin host is rewritten to
  `PUBLIC_HOST`, because the Next proxy builds absolute redirects from the
  request host. No other response header is changed except `X-Gateway-Cache`.
- **Origin `Cache-Control`:** ignored on cacheable routes by default (dynamic
  Next pages send `private, no-store`). Set
  `GATEWAY_RESPECT_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL=true` to honour `no-store` and
  `private`.
- **Failure:** missing `WEB_ORIGIN` returns `500`, an unreachable origin `502`,
  and a request that already passed through the gateway (`x-gateway-hop`) `508`.

## Configuration

| Name | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WEB_ORIGIN` | variable, set at deploy | Vercel production web origin, `https://<hostname>`. Must not be `tuturuuu.com` itself (that loops back). |
| `PUBLIC_HOST` | variable | Public hostname for redirect rewriting. Default `tuturuuu.com`. |
| `GATEWAY_MODE` | variable | `active` or `passthrough` (rollback flag). |
| `GATEWAY_RESPECT_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL` | variable | `true` honours origin `no-store`/`private`. |

No secrets are used. The Vercel origin hostname has to accept requests for its
own host; a custom origin hostname such as `origin.tuturuuu.com` must be added
as a domain on the Vercel web project before cutover.

## Cutover packet

Deploy (provider owner):

```bash
cd apps/gateway
bunx wrangler deploy --var WEB_ORIGIN:https://<vercel-web-hostname>
```

The route `tuturuuu.com/*` comes from `wrangler.jsonc`. Record the prior Vercel
production deployment id before the first deploy; Vercel keeps serving
`tuturuuu.com` unchanged until the route is attached.

Pre-flight smoke against the Worker with the route not yet attached is not
possible, so deploy first with `GATEWAY_MODE=passthrough`, verify, then switch:

```bash
node apps/gateway/scripts/gateway-smoke.mjs --base https://tuturuuu.com \
  --origin https://<vercel-web-hostname> --expect-mode passthrough
# after switching the variable to active:
node apps/gateway/scripts/gateway-smoke.mjs --base https://tuturuuu.com \
  --origin https://<vercel-web-hostname>
```

The smoke script checks 17 anonymous public URLs (`200`, second request served
from cache, no `Set-Cookie` on cacheable responses), the login page, that an
anonymous dashboard path redirects to login on the public host, that session
cookies and `Authorization` bypass the cache, and that `Set-Cookie` names match
the origin when `--origin` is given.

## Rollback

1. Fastest, keeps the Worker: set `GATEWAY_MODE=passthrough` (variable change,
   no code deploy). The Worker becomes a transparent proxy with no cache reads
   or writes.
2. Full removal: delete the `tuturuuu.com/*` route (or the Worker) in the
   Cloudflare dashboard. Traffic returns to the unchanged Vercel deployment.
3. No purge is needed: cache entries expire within 65 minutes and are
   never read in `passthrough` mode.

## Local checks

```bash
cd apps/gateway
vp test
vp lint --config .oxlintrc.json src --deny-warnings
```

## Marketing page groups

The gateway can serve a page group from the `apps/marketing` Worker instead of the Vercel web origin. Each group is one flag.

| Group | Paths |
| --- | --- |
| `legal` | `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/acceptable-use`, `/community-guidelines`, `/security`, `/legal/*`, `/security/*` |
| `company` | `/about`, `/branding`, `/careers`, `/contact`, `/contributors`, `/partners`, `/women-in-tech` |
| `products` | `/products`, `/products/*` |
| `solutions` | `/solutions/*` |
| `blog` | `/blog`, `/blog/*` |
| `home` | `/`, `/pricing` |

`/changelog`, `/download`, `/models`, `/meet`, `/meet-together`, `/portfolio`, `/qr-generator` and `/visualizations/*` always stay on the web origin.

Two Worker variables control the flip:

- `MARKETING_ORIGIN`: the `https://` origin of the marketing Worker. Without it, every group stays on web.
- `GATEWAY_MARKETING_GROUPS`: comma-separated group names served by the marketing origin, for example `legal,company`.

Flip a group by adding its name and redeploying the gateway variables. Roll it back by removing the name, or by clearing `GATEWAY_MARKETING_GROUPS`. Cached pages from the other origin are keyed separately and expire within the cache window, so a rollback is complete within one stale period.

Smoke for each group before the next one: anonymous 200 on two paths of the group, `x-gateway-cache` present, and `x-tuturuuu-runtime: native` on a cache MISS from the marketing origin.

`/assets/*` is the Vite build output of the marketing app. It always goes to `MARKETING_ORIGIN` (cached as static) and falls back to the web origin while `MARKETING_ORIGIN` is unset. It is not tied to a page-group flag, so rolling a group back does not move `/assets/*`; Vercel web has no `/assets` path.
